title: A connector that names sides leaves and enters along them only in a straight route
body:
`Connector` in `crates/acre/src/scene/connector.rs` stores only `from` and `to`. `Connector::path` picks an elbow's shape from the longer axis between the ends, so it always draws three segments turning halfway. A connector that names sides, such as `from build left; to unmasked top; route elbow`, draws a horizontal-vertical-horizontal Z and the arrowhead enters the top edge sideways. It should leave `build` along x and enter `unmasked` along y with one turn.

A curve has the same flaw. The approved proposal in acre-1eb1c3 says its handles run along each end's side, and the code puts them along the longer axis.

## Proposal

`Connector` carries an optional outward direction for each end, set from the side the `end` function in `build.rs` resolves. A bare point or a bare name has none. Elbow draws an L for perpendicular directions and a Z for parallel ones. A curve's handles run along the directions. An end with no direction keeps today's rule.
